### Dataset:

Edges represent co-purchase relationships — two products are connected if customers frequently buy them together.

narrative: The GNN model predicted the "Movies & TV" category for the target product, Chilly Dogs, with a high confidence level of 99.65%. This prediction was significantly influenced by the presence of certain words within the product description, especially the word "use," which appeared multiple times and was among the most influential features. Interestingly, the absence of the word "pack" played a role, suggesting it might have been linked to non-movie categories. The target product's direct co-purchase connection with another Movies & TV category item, "Snow Dogs," strongly supported the prediction, as this relationship indicates a pattern where customers who purchase one often buy the other. Furthermore, all products within the one-hop neighborhood belonged to the "Movies & TV" category, reinforcing the prediction. Additional strength came from the two-hop neighbor connections, such as "My Favorite Martian" and "Eight Below (Widescreen Edition)," which all belonged to the same category and contributed to creating a cohesive web of associated movie titles. These connections suggested a thematic and consumer behavior alignment consistent with typical movie and television content purchasing patterns, further solidifying the categorization under "Movies & TV."
